text:
anya: Heads-up — console is showing a growing count of 'rehydration' jobs for hourly aggregates in EU-1, looks like ~18k queued. Not sure if it's telemetry lag or a double-submit from the replay service.
devon: I saw the same, noticed a burst of reprocess jobs around 02:12 UTC. Metrics show CPU on dedicated replayers went to 95%.
matt: Did anyone kick an automated backfill or a schema migration?
lia: No manual. My guess: the new ingest dedupe flag & the replay backoff change triggered retries + rehydrate task creation.
anya: Cost spike alert fired. We need to rate-limit new rehydrates while we triage — don't want to saturate Dedicated pools.
devon: Proposal: route non-urgent reprocesses to a low-priority queue (priority=background) and add a per-tenant token bucket so one tenant can't blow capacity.
matt: +1. Also we need a small API change: reprocess endpoint should accept ?priority=background|interactive and X-Dry-Run header for preflight cost estimate.
lia: Agree on priority param. But careful — console rollouts use the existing reprocess API; changing params will need console + api lib sync.
anya: Can we keep backwards compatibility: default priority=interactive (current behavior), and new header X-Reprocess-Priority? Console can send it once feature-flagged.
devon: I worry about dashboard consistency: the console aggregates page currently sums "queued" across all lanes. If we add lanes, the count will look smaller but backlog is still there. Need UI to show lane breakdown.
matt: Yeah, split view: Queued (interactive) | Queued (background) and a small tooltip about service-level guarantees.
lia: Ops-bot just posted: "replayer: 03:10 spike - 4 worker OOMs, autoscale triggered".
ops-bot: replayer: 03:10 spike - 4 worker OOMs, autoscale triggered :warning:
anya: For safety, let's throttle enqueue rate at API ingress for background lanes. Implement a token-per-tenant + global refill rate. If tenant exceeds daily refill, enqueue fails with 429 + message about quota.
devon: Implementation details: token key = tenant_id:rehydration:tokens, use Redis leaky-bucket, refill rate configurable per cluster. Also add metrics: tokens_granted, tokens_denied, tokens_in_use.
matt: Console needs a preflight UI: when a user submits a rehydrate, we call /reprocess?dry_run=true which returns estimate {tokens_needed: N, cost_estimate_usd: $X, duration_minutes: Y, confidence: 0.7}. Show that in modal along with priority selector.
lia: Small API sketch:
```
POST /v1/reprocess
Headers: X-Tenant, X-Dry-Run: true|false, X-Reprocess-Priority: interactive|background
Body: { "time_range": "2026-02-10T00:00Z/2026-02-10T03:00Z", "aggregate": "hourly" }
```
devon: For dry_run, return an estimate computed from sampled shard sizes + current KV-cache hit rate. Confidence score if sample variance high.
anya: QA + rollout plan: feature flag behind backend/console flags. Start routing 5% of background requests to low-priority lane for 24h, monitor latency/cost + queued counts.
matt: Need automatic fallback: if background lane saturates, requests should fallback to interactive lane but with a note and higher cost. Or better: reject with 429 to avoid surprise cost.
devon: Also add an operator endpoint to move queued jobs between lanes for emergency rescue. That helps if we need to drain interactive and dump long tails to background.
lia: Telemetry note: current "recompute-ops" dashboard assumes single queue. We should add new panels: lane_breakdown, per-tenant_token_usage, dry_run_accuracy over time.
anya: Who wants to own the API change + token implementation? I can take the token redis + metrics work.
matt: I'll pick up console modal + dry_run wiring.
devon: I'll own server API + routing. Lia can update dashboards.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: created deployment job replayer-v2-canary in cluster eu-1 for autoscale fixes.
anya: Cool. Timeline: implement token bucket + dry_run API by EOD Wednesday, then console hookup Thursday, canary 5% Friday.
matt: One more ask: show dry_run confidence on the modal as a progress bar and link to sample set used. Users will want transparency.
lia: Agreed. Also add a checkbox "sample-only rehydrate" that will only create sample tasks (10%) so users can verify outputs before a full run.
devon: Good idea. We'll also record a small audit event for any reprocess created (tenant, time_range, priority, sample=true/false).
anya: Ok let's triage current queue: I'll run a quick query to surface top 10 tenants by queued tasks and DM owners.
matt: Thanks. Post any findings here. :thumbsup:
